desc:
🥊 Step into the ring and become the CHAMPION! 🏆

Train at the gym, win fights, and advance in rank from Beginner to Champion. Every hit counts!

🔥 WHAT YOU CAN DO:
🥊 Professional fights against players or against AI, featuring ring entry, rounds, knockdowns, and KOs
💪 Gym: bench, dumbbells, bag, and treadmill to increase Strength, Agility, and Speed instantly
⚔️ Challenge any player in the lobby and fight in a ring instantly
🏆 Ranks and seasons: show who's in charge
📅 Daily missions and rewards every day
🛒 Store: gloves, shorts, kits, and robes for your boxer
🔄 Rebirth to become even stronger

📱 Works on PC, mobile phones, and tablets.

👍 Like and join the group to stay updated on new releases!

Boxing game · Fighting · Training · Simulator · Knockout · Ranked
